dedupeText: patchwork folk illustration quilt patchwork folk art vintage illustration country aesthetic heraldic crest nature scene the central crest acts as a clean structured window against the busy organic texture of the quilt the yellow and red typography provides a high contrast focal point against the blue and green of the illustration the repeating geometric grid of the quilt creates a rhythmic tactile frame for the central graphic combine a textile texture background with a central illustrative crest featuring heavy block typography and nature icons to create a folk revival aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, vertically oriented rectangular crest containing a nature illustration and stylized typography, overlaid on a full-frame background of a multi-colored, square-patterned patchwork quilt.
coreVisualRelationships: The central crest acts as a clean, structured window against the busy, organic texture of the quilt.
The yellow and red typography provides a high-contrast focal point against the blue and green of the illustration.
The repeating geometric grid of the quilt creates a rhythmic, tactile frame for the central graphic.
coreInvariants: A full-bleed background of a handmade-style patchwork quilt.
A central rectangular frame with a thin yellow border.
A nature-themed illustration featuring pine trees and a sun within the frame.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central crest is positioned in the upper-middle third of the frame, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, yellow block-lettering at the top of the crest serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top yellow text, moves down through the central nature illustration, follows the curved banner, and rests on the bottom red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The quilt background provides a textured 'negative space' that surrounds the central graphic element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (greens, browns, creams) in the quilt background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Sky blue in the central illustration panel.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and deep red for the primary typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is low-saturation and medium-value, while the central graphic uses high-saturation primary colors to pop forward.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic colors; maintain a natural, sun-faded textile palette.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, uniform strokes for the top display text.
Black drop shadows to create a 3D effect.
Curved baseline for the middle banner text.
Slightly distressed or hand-painted texture on the letter fills.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to fit the width of the central frame.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking a heavy block display face with a curved banner-style serif and a bottom-weighted slab serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed block feel of the top text.
Provides the sturdy slab-serif foundation for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a vintage, handmade patchwork quilt made of small squares in various patterns (plaid, floral, solid) and colors (green, tan, red, blue). In the center, place a vertical rectangular frame with a sky-blue background and a simple folk-art illustration of two green pine trees and a yellow sun.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text: a large yellow block-letter title at the top with black shadows, a green curved banner in the middle with yellow lettering, and a two-line red slab-serif title at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the quilt texture visible and tactile?
Does the central crest have a distinct yellow border?
Are the drop shadows on the text consistent in direction?
Is the nature illustration stylized rather than realistic?

mustRedesign: Exact textile patterns that might be trademarked

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between text and background
Vibrant but slightly aged color palette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the illustration.
Check that the quilt patterns look like fabric, not digital noise.
Verify the 'window' effect of the central crest.
Confirm the presence of the black drop shadows on the main text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Textile Texture Background] with a [Central Illustrative Crest] featuring [Heavy Block Typography] and [Nature Icons] to create a [Folk-Revival Aesthetic].
